dmz.quest.makuo1.name: Violet Eclipse
dmz.quest.makuo1.desc: A violet shadow covers Namek's sun. The Namekians say the sky is "weeping crystal": something is falling from space onto their villages. Travel to Namek.
dmz.quest.makuo2.name: Words of the Grand Elder
dmz.quest.makuo2.desc: The Grand Elder felt the eclipse before anyone else. Talk to him: "That color... I saw it in my ancestors' memories. There was a Namekian we erased from history. His name was Makuo."
dmz.quest.makuo3.name: Crystal Eggs
dmz.quest.makuo3.desc: The violet eggs hatch into black-armored warriors: the Zhar, children of Makuo. They are hunting Namek's Dragon Balls. Defeat 12 Zhar Warriors.
dmz.quest.makuo4.name: The Crystal Fist
dmz.quest.makuo4.desc: Garuk, the First Herald, lands among the fallen Zhar: "Father does not want Namek. Only what you took from him. Step aside and live." Defeat him.
dmz.quest.makuo5.name: Preparing the Jump
dmz.quest.makuo5.desc: Vharos lies at the edge of the galaxy and the eclipse warps space. The space pod needs 16 amethyst shards to stabilize the jump, 12 iron ingots for the hull and 8 glowstone dust to navigate. Once done, the pod can travel to Vharos.
dmz.quest.makuo6.name: Course for Vharos
dmz.quest.makuo6.desc: Board the space pod and choose the new destination: Vharos. A planet of violet grass and amethyst seas, with no sun.
dmz.quest.makuo7.name: The Last Guardian
dmz.quest.makuo7.desc: Among the ruins of the Namekian camp, near your landing site, an old man waits for you: Saien, the last Guardian of the Chain. Talk to him.
dmz.quest.makuo8.name: Ash and Crystal
dmz.quest.makuo8.desc: The Zhar have sensed your ki and surround Saien's camp. Defeat 16 Zhar Warriors.
dmz.quest.makuo9.name: The Voice of the Void
dmz.quest.makuo9.desc: Seiryn, the Second Herald, floats above the amethyst sea: "Your ki is so... bright. Father will enjoy it." He is a sorcerer: don't let him fight from afar.
dmz.quest.makuo10.name: Void Shards
dmz.quest.makuo10.desc: Saien knows how to weaken Makuo's wings: a seal made from his own crystal. Zhar Elites carry shards of the Void Heart. Defeat 6 of them and gather 4 Void Shards.
dmz.quest.makuo11.name: The Shadow
dmz.quest.makuo11.desc: Something follows you without a sound: Vokkar, the Third Herald. "Garuk was strength. Seiryn was power. I am what you never see coming." Defeat him.
dmz.quest.makuo12.name: The Citadel Gates
dmz.quest.makuo12.desc: Saien engraves the seal on your hands: "When he spreads his wings, the seal will make them visible to your ki." Head north, about 300 blocks from the camp (X 0, Z -300): Makuo's Citadel stands there.
dmz.quest.makuo13.name: Drakhul, the Colossus
dmz.quest.makuo13.desc: Before the empty throne stands Drakhul, Makuo's firstborn: "My brothers were Heralds. I am their shield. You shall not pass." Careful: Namekians can grow giant.
dmz.quest.makuo14.name: Wings of the Void
dmz.quest.makuo14.desc: Makuo descends from the Void Heart, unhurried: "Six hundred years watching the stars... and the first light that comes to see me is you." At half health he will spread the Wings of the Void. Defeat him.
dmz.quest.makuo15.name: Dawn
dmz.quest.makuo15.desc: The Void Heart goes dark and, for the first time in six hundred years, a pale sun rises over Vharos. Saien stays behind: "Someone has to tell the stars the chain is no longer needed." Return to Namek and talk to the Grand Elder.
entity.makuosaga.saga_seiryn: Seiryn, the Voice of the Void
dialogue.dragonminez.story.sidequest.sai: Six hundred years guarding a chain... If you came to break it for good, don't waste your time with me. Head north when you are ready.
There were twelve of us. Makuo let us live so we could watch the chain break. The others turned to crystal centuries ago.
You will not defeat him while his Heralds feed him light. Them first. Then him.
You did what twelve guardians could not in six hundred years. Thank you.
message.makuosaga.vharos.arrival: §5Vharos§r — You sense an ancient, cold ki to the north. Someone is watching you from the nearby ruins.
